summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register a combined offering of 25 million shares of common stock and warrants to purchase up to 25 million shares, with a combined price of $0.40 per unit. The last sale price was $0.3952. Ladenburg Thalmann acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, with fees of $0.024 per unit. No special situation is triggered; this is a routine public equity offering with warrants, not a restructuring, rights offering, or other special event. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, going-private transaction, or any other enumerated special category.
